provenance: Project-authored summary of local experiment records and implementation checks; not a vendor benchmark or third-party reproduction.
publication_scope: Aggregate results and limitations only. Private raw receipts, credentials, machine paths and user prompts are not published. This summary alone is not independent proof of model execution.

model.scope: The following native match outcomes use FP32, not the 4-bit variant, TypeSafe Jev, or Copilot.

representation_development.observation: An earlier engage-first FP32 match recorded 20 completed requests and zero firing attempts. Twelve tank decisions had a geometrically clear shot but chose movement. Compact text and neutral action names did not fix the sampled development inputs.
representation_development.confounds: That match also had 11855 ms of rate-admission wait while the opponent continued. Later input facts, candidate filtering, readout and rate handling changed together; no single-factor causal attribution is established.

negative_evidence.conclusion: Model scoring did not improve win count over pure search and left less HP in the two differing held-out outcomes.

limitations: Three new boards with shared effect templates, not disjoint textual generalization or a population win-rate estimate.
Survival v2 and the new planner differ in reload eligibility and other controller details: this is a package comparison, not an isolated model/search causal test.
Main observed improvement belongs to planning/controller changes; it does not establish newly learned combat skill.

v6_realtime_observations.scope: Actual HTTP arena, worker search and native local inference; physics continued during search/inference. No synthetic dispatch-delay substitution.
v6_realtime_observations.scope_limit: Four observations, not a general win-rate or model-over-search superiority claim; decision times are not pure GPU inference latency.

friendly_fire.verified: Deterministic first-tank collision, friendly HP/shield accounting, joint firing-lane checks, replay/export and injected-score UI tests.
friendly_fire.scope_limit: The earlier v6 model victories are not v7 evidence. Zero friendly contacts in four search-only smoke games is not a safety guarantee.

online_scoring.verified: Injected CLI replies through HTTP/worker/provider/parser/UI, including consent, exact score validation, cancellation and no native fallback.
online_scoring.scores: Original 0..100 self-preferences, not native Boolean probabilities; division by 100 is application arithmetic only.
online_scoring.scope_limit: Compatibility tests do not establish cloud-model tactical quality, latency, access or quota.

generalization_boundary: These engineering practices are candidates for other bounded decision systems. Revalidate domain quality, latency, calibration, permissions and execution safety; do not transfer the game's coefficients or win counts as universal defaults.
